name: Spools
description: Cotton reels standing in rows like a haberdasher's shelf: wooden flanges top and bottom and the colored thread between them, some reels fuller than others.

code.style: --rule: ( --z0: @r(1); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: scale(.9); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--wood); clip-path: @var(--wood); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 25%; top: 19.6%; width: 50%; height: 60.8%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); transform: scaleX(@r(.55, 1)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4.4%, #00000080 4.4% 6%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 4.4%, #00000080 4.4% 6%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
